scenarios.title: Read and write simple structured data.

outputs.name: ElementsRead
outputs.note: Strings read back from the memory stream after Copy Strings, one per line

scenarios.expectedBehavior: Clicking 'Copy Strings' writes the strings via DataWriter into a memory stream then reads them back via DataReader, displaying each on its own line in ElementsRead.

scenarios.title: Dump file contents using ReadBytes().

outputs.name: ReadBytesOutput
outputs.note: Monospaced hex dump of the embedded PNG image bytes

scenarios.expectedBehavior: Clicking 'Hex Dump' opens a sequential-access stream over the bundled image, reads bytes with ReadBytes(), and renders a formatted hex dump (offset + hex columns) in ReadBytesOutput.
